source_context.summary: Fresh corrected-authority Phase-5 trial using the validated Phase-3 bounded-chunk-loading shadow candidate unchanged.

records.statement: Queued chunk loads are scheduled nearest-first with deterministic tie-breaking and bounded by per-frame start and concurrent-load limits.
Residency remains responsible for which chunk coordinates should eventually exist, while loading scheduling decides which queued requests may enter LOADING next.
Offline generation, Surface Nets, chunk baking, and manifest contracts remain unchanged by prioritized bounded loading.
The feature does not introduce LOD, hysteresis, prediction, visibility weighting, memory policy, runtime procedural generation, or Dual Contouring.
Validation was designed to expose queued priority and active loading under deliberately small budgets while retaining the existing Web thread smoke test and baked terrain fixture.
